title: 2004 AMC8 14
statement: What is the area enclosed by the geoboard quadrilateral below?

solutions.text:
Place the quadrilateral inside the surrounding \(10\times10\) square, whose area is \(100.\)

The five outside pieces have areas \(15,\) \(\frac12\cdot6\cdot7=21,\) \(\frac12\cdot1\cdot3=\frac32,\) \(\frac12\cdot4\cdot5=10,\) and \(\frac12\cdot6\cdot10=30.\)

The outside area is \(15+21+\frac32+10+30=77\frac12,\) so the quadrilateral area is \(100-77\frac12=22\frac12.\)

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Put the quadrilateral inside an easy surrounding square.
Subtract the outside rectangles and right triangles from the surrounding square.
